The Ground Truth Answer states that the United States Air Force was "22 years old" when the 317th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron was inactivated. The Predicted Answer provides additional details (dates of establishment and inactivation), but ultimately concludes that the Air Force was "about 22 years old (rounded to the nearest year)".
